title: linkshare: a Rails app for shared links

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Post a link, and a nice preview card appears. How does the site know what to show?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's linkshare, a Ruby on Rails project where people share links, comment and vote.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So it fetches the title and picture itself?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. It pulls OpenGraph metadata in the background, so the page doesn't wait, and then shows a card preview.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What else is in the app?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Pages are rendered on the server, and there are user accounts and an administrative interface. It has Minitest tests too. It was a learning project, and it covers a full web app from accounts to moderation. The written page has more.
